scope: Basic local profile, derived level and durable learning homepage. Full 11.4 performance/compatibility and the 11.5 phase gate remain unaccepted.
contracts: All frozen public contracts1.0.0, P0-C V1.0, DB physical1 nine stores; Blockly/learning release1.0.2 unchanged
behaviors: Four controlled original SVG presets plus canonical #RRGGBB persist across refresh; no URL/Base64/HTML storage
Posted ledger only, exact BigInt totals; no persisted level, score or progress percentage; no upgrade rewards
Home course counts, points dialog and compatible continue location derive from durable snapshot; temporary facts are excluded
Unknown historical preset preserved and explicitly unavailable until a deliberate choice; invalid intermediate hex never becomes SVG fill
Avatar CAS and generation barriers; quota failure retains draft and old saved home; stale tab cannot overwrite winner
Clear discards stale draft and resets new archive to default avatar and Lv.1; no old rights revived
Damaged ledger remains preserved and level unconfirmed; valid historical large sums remain exact
Successful refresh only clears the same draft object; edits made while a previous read awaits acknowledgment survive

verification.rust: Unchanged; no new Rust test claim. Prior 374-test acceptance retained.

initialFailures.explanation: Six of seven passed. The real three-group result, 35 points, Lv.2 and refresh had passed; the evidence helper then requested a Worker capture after a real reload had correctly discarded it. Capture now occurs before reload. Raw failure trace retained, product and waits/deadlines unchanged.
initialFailures.uiHarnessExplanation: First jsdom test setup attempted spyOn on absent native dialog methods. Explicit local showModal/close mechanics stubs fixed the harness; final nine UI tests passed.

stockFirefoxFirst.explanation: Sixth exercise accepted all six groups and saved; return-to-lesson native click was intercepted below the viewport. Native wheel positioning now waits for stable geometry and a visible unobscured center before one native click. No failed-click retry or product/deadline change. Separate final run follows.

limitations: Browser Date is fixed for deterministic local-day assertions; performance clock and real Rust remain active
Quota is targeted native API fault injection, not physical disk exhaustion
Unknown historical preset and huge posted ledger are explicitly isolated compatibility simulations, not real earned-score evidence
Stock Firefox uses native controls and readonly snapshots, with no Worker patch, seeded facts or application imports; its 185-point course assertion assumes one local date
08.4-PERF-01 and 11.1-QA-EDGE-LAZY-01 remain for 11.4; no full phase or performance claim
